facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - electrical exposure at SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-3100 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 1 February 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on SG-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
